name: data-database-async-dml-list-runtime
salesforceExclusionReason: Async DML completion is locally materialized; this fixture does not claim hosted external-object behavior.

evidence.notes: Explicit List<Object> async insert returns two successful results and persists both Accounts.
Explicit List<Object> async insert with AccessLevel returns successful results and persists both Accounts.
Explicit List<Object> async update returns successful results and persists changed names.
Explicit List<Object> async update with AccessLevel persists changed names.
Explicit List<Object> async delete returns successful results and marks both Accounts deleted.
Explicit List<Object> async delete with AccessLevel marks both Accounts deleted.

source.content: List<Object> plainInserts = new List<Object>{new Account(Name = 'List Plain Insert One'), new Account(Name = 'List Plain Insert Two')}; List<Database.SaveResult> plainInsertResults = Database.insertAsync(plainInserts); System.assertEquals(2, plainInsertResults.size()); System.assert(plainInsertResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(plainInsertResults[1].isSuccess()); List<Object> accessInserts = new List<Object>{new Account(Name = 'List Access Insert One'), new Account(Name = 'List Access Insert Two')}; List<Database.SaveResult> accessInsertResults = Database.insertAsync(accessInserts, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, accessInsertResults.size()); Account p1 = (Account)plainInserts[0]; Account p2 = (Account)plainInserts[1]; p1.Name = 'List Plain Update One'; p2.Name = 'List Plain Update Two'; System.assertEquals(2, Database.updateAsync(plainInserts).size()); Account a1 = (Account)accessInserts[0]; Account a2 = (Account)accessInserts[1]; a1.Name = 'List Access Update One'; a2.Name = 'List Access Update Two'; System.assertEquals(2, Database.updateAsync(accessInserts, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); List<Account> changed = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Id IN :new Set<Id>{p1.Id,p2.Id,a1.Id,a2.Id}]; System.assertEquals(4, changed.size()); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'List Plain Update One']); List<Object> plainDeletes = new List<Object>{p1,p2}; System.assertEquals(2, Database.deleteAsync(plainDeletes).size()); List<Object> accessDeletes = new List<Object>{a1,a2}; System.assertEquals(2, Database.deleteAsync(accessDeletes, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); List<Account> deleted = [SELECT Id, IsDeleted FROM Account WHERE Id IN :new Set<Id>{p1.Id,p2.Id,a1.Id,a2.Id} ALL ROWS]; System.assertEquals(4, deleted.size()); for (Account row : deleted) { System.assert(row.IsDeleted); }
